sloka: समुद्रम् राघवो राजा शरणम् गन्तुम् अर्हति ।खानितः सगरेण अयम् अप्रमेयो महाउदधिः ॥६-१९-३१॥।।
transliteration: samudram rāghavo rājā śaraṇam gantum arhati ।khānitaḥ sagareṇa ayam aprameyo mahāudadhiḥ ॥6-19-31॥।।

translations.english: "Excellent and meaningful words have been said by sage Kandu (about one who protects a refugee), that is by doing one's righteous duty. He will be not only famous but reach heaven as a result of his action."
translations.hindi: तो वह रक के समस्त पुण्यां को ले अर्राक्षत शरणागत व्यक्ति चला जाता हे । अतएव शरण में आए हुए की रक्ता न करने से बड़ा भारी पाप लगता है
